title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
gist: Anthropic opens a ~14-day call for life-science guest investigators to run 8–12 week funded-compute collaborations with its researchers on causal human biology, molecular biology, drug discovery and clinical science, with open-sourced outputs and data rights retained by the investigators.

insights.claim: Anthropic is inviting academic, nonprofit and government-lab principal investigators to 8–12 week collaborations with its researchers on causal human biology, structural and computational molecular biology, medicinal chemistry, drug discovery and clinical science, running its models and harnesses at no cost to them.
insights.speaker: @AnthropicAI
insights.so_what: Shows frontier labs seeking domain-science validation of models; a possible pipeline for AI-for-drug-discovery results.
insights.locator: Today, we're inviting members of the life sciences community

insights.claim: Guest investigators keep rights to their data and to independent follow-on research, outputs will be published and open-sourced, and applicants are asked to include only publicly available information.
insights.speaker: @AnthropicAI
insights.so_what: The IP-friendly terms lower barriers for institutions and set a norm for lab–academia AI collaboration.

insights.claim: Anthropic wants proposals that can show preliminary evidence within the short window while acknowledging that results on most open problems take far longer to validate.
insights.speaker: @AnthropicAI
insights.so_what: Expect early outputs to be preliminary datasets and tools, not validated drug candidates.
insights.locator: We understand that the results for most open problems

insights.claim: The program is one of several Anthropic life-sciences initiatives, alongside a Life Sciences Verification Program giving scientists direct access to its most capable public models for biology and an AI for Science program providing Claude credits.
insights.speaker: @AnthropicAI
insights.so_what: Anthropic is investing more heavily in biology as a vertical; watch for follow-on announcements and partnerships.
insights.locator: This program is one of several initiatives
